@everyone CHARITY STREAM: SAT NOV 21, 10am to 10pm

posting this early bc last year half of u found out the day of and we ended at $212. not this time lol

this year it's for the Linden Community Pantry. they're feeding around 340 families a week rn, and Denise (who runs it) said the shelves are the lowest she's seen before thanksgiving. through their wholesale partner every $1 gets about 4 lbs of food, so even $3 is like 12 lbs. it goes straight to them, nothing taken off.

donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz

goal is $600
rook is matching the first $100, so the first 100 bucks literally counts double 🙏

incentives (shoutout the mods for these):
$100: i play a full round with the controller upside down
$250: chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM
$400: 1 hour of only chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600: i vlog a grocery pickup the pantry sets up (ur donations go to them and they buy the food)

what we're playing: first half is community lobbies, anyone can join, i'll drop the code. second half chat votes on a new game every 2 hrs. no repeat maps larry i promise

no card? u can still help:
- drop canned or boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry's side door (saturdays 9 to 1)
- send the link to ur family or post it somewhere
- just show up and hang out or hop in a lobby. more ppl in chat = more ppl see the link

and to the "charity streams are cringe" ppl lol i get it. nobody's getting guilt tripped and nobody's getting called out for not donating. it's a 12 hr stream where u might get to pick my hair color and a food pantry gets stocked before thanksgiving. that's the whole thing. come hang either way

see u on the 21st 🫡
